name: Shanai Dorei ~ Bihin ni Ochita Mesu no Matsuro
original_name: 社内奴隷～備品に堕ちた牝の末路
source:
Reiko, director of financial department, caught an evidence of corporate fraud.

Before she was about to prosecute, she was captured by the evil hand of humiliates.

She is violated by ex coworkers as well as apprentices, and forced to perform hentai acts at various locations.
What will happen to this corporate slave...?

就在她准备起诉前，却被羞辱者的邪恶之手抓住。
